questions.question: The status bar sits above the tab bar while anything works ('4 working · T1'). How should it go?

options.label: Remove it entirely (Recommended)
options.description: Delete the bar; working sessions still show in the lists.

options.label: Setting, off by default
options.description: Keep it behind a switch in Settings.

options.label: Hide it on iPad only
options.description: The iPad's sidebar already shows what works.
